title: El Porfiriato
goal: Read how Porfirio Díaz's 34-year rule combined real economic modernization with extreme land concentration and "pan o palo" repression, and what triggered the 1910 crisis.
grammar: Llevar + gerundio: cuánto tiempo llevaba ocurriendo algo

items: State how long Díaz had been governing Mexico by 1910.
Explain what the Porfiriato had been concentrating at an extraordinary rate.
Describe the "pan o palo" style of governing.
Explain the error Díaz made in 1910 after promising free elections.
Use llevar + gerund to express how long something had already been happening.
